# Overcoming Temptation
## Scripture
"For God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of self-discipline." – 2 Timothy 1:7
## Reflection
As men, we face countless temptations each day that can distract us from our purpose and mission. The enemy of our souls is always looking for ways to undermine our resolve and lead us astray. But we don't have to be controlled by fear. Instead, we can be empowered by the Holy Spirit to overcome temptation and live a life of integrity. Self-discipline is not about being perfect, but about being intentional with our time, energy, and resources. It's about recognizing the areas where we are vulnerable and taking steps to protect ourselves. As we seek to grow in self-discipline, we will become more effective warriors for Christ, better equipped to face the challenges of this world.

## Daily Challenge
"Do 10 minutes of intense physical training while focusing on a specific area of self-discipline you want to improve."
